## Left open by the earlier read (RD-052)

An independent reader judged the previous rewrite of this lesson. Fix everything below as well. Each item is as serious as an item under "Fix these".

### Findings

1. Rule L09 (Minor). Problem: The hard Filipino focus labels tagaganap and layon first appear in example #11 without English glosses. Earlier explanation of actor and affected thing gives their meaning but does not supply the required first-use glosses for these labels.
   > Siya ang gumagawa ng pagluluto, kaya nasa tagaganap ang pokus ng *nagluto*.
2. Rule L18 (Major). Problem: The lesson teaches collective nouns treated as separate members, but the only worked collective-noun task (#3) tests an American-English group acting as one. The distinct member-based plural case still has no worked example.
   > Plural agreement can stress the separate members, especially in British English.
